name: Search fund
description: One searcher, investor-backed, buying a single small business to run. Smaller floors, lower multiples, heavier SBA-style leverage, and less tolerance for revenue concentration because there is no portfolio to absorb a lost customer.

owner-compensation.rationale: The searcher becomes the CEO and draws a salary. Only the gap between the owner's pay and the searcher's own salary is a real add-back, so this is credited at half.
